title: 1st Berlin International Film Festival (1951) — Golden Bear: Golden Bear: multiple, incl. Four in a Jeep
t: 1st Berlin International Film Festival (1951) — Golden Bear: Golden Bear: multiple, incl. Four in a Jeep
description:
1st Berlin International Film Festival — held June 6-17, 1951 at West Berlin.

The top honor, Golden Bear, went to Golden Bear: multiple, incl. Four in a Jeep. The first Berlinale awarded Golden Bears by category in divided Cold War Berlin.

Founded as a 'window to the West' — culture as Cold War diplomacy.

This ceremony belongs to the Berlin International Film Festival's long arc from its founding to the present: each year's winners capture what the Berlin valued most — the films, records, shows, and books that defined their moment.

  "2024": "74th Berlin International Film Festival — Dahomey",
  "1998": "48th Berlin International Film Festival — Central Station",
  "2015": "65th Berlin International Film Festival — Taxi"

def lookup(key):
    """Return the ceremony and top winner for a given year."""
    return DATA.get(str(key), "No entry for %%s" %% key)

def all_keys():

    return {k: v for k, v in DATA.items() if t in str(v).lower()}

if __name__ == "__main__":
